messages.body_plain:
Dear scholars,

I'm a beginner of Rsiena software, start learning from June of this year
for my PhD thesis. I read the Rsiena mannual and dowload the "50s pupil"
data but I can't figure out how to get the estimation and standard error of
covariate.Is it calculate from covariance matrices? I can't completely
understand the manual as my English is not very good but I'm so eager to
know all the knowledge about Rsiena, it is so helpful for my research.
Thank you so much. The attachment is result of my data processed by Rsiena.
Is it possible to help me analyse this result? Which is the covariate
estimation and standard error? Thanks a lot

I'm looking forward to hearing from you.

Yours sincerely,

Jieyao zhang

messages.body_plain:
Dear Jieyao,

For this type of question, the siena/stocnet list is more appropriate.
The address is http://groups.yahoo.com/groups/stocnet/.
The R-Forge list is meant mainly for discussion about coding.

But let me answer you anyway here. On the Siena website there is a page
http://www.stats.ox.ac.uk/~snijders/siena/siena_scripts.htm
with R scripts. The scripts Rscript01DataFormat.R,  Rscript02SienaVariableFormat.R, Rscript03SienaRunModel.R, and Rscript04SienaBehaviour.R together give a lot of introductory material. When you have gone through them, I hope you will have found the answer to your question. When further questions arise, please ask again!

Best wishes,
Tom


================================================================
Tom A.B. Snijders
Professor of Statistics in the Social Sciences
Department of Politics and Department of Statistics
Nuffield College
University of Oxford
tel. +44-01865-278599
